description: Form 4797 instructions, line 8 example: net § 1231 losses of $4,000 (2020) and $6,000 (2021), gains of $3,000 (2024) and $2,000 (2025): line 8 is $7,000, 'The entire $2,000 net section 1231 gain on line 7 is treated as ordinary income', and '$5,000 of section 1231 losses from 2021 left to recapture'.
